items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Because (Buddy?) told me about it. ... He looked like Buddy Rogers used to look, you know.

ctx.x: Well what's in the Smithsonian Institute you said?
Oh, 'Knee Drops' and something else. Because (Buddy?) told me about it.
Yes. But I don't remember ( Unintelligible ?) I heard him saying he saw it in the Smithsonian Institute.
